reflection: The notebook shows that volume-contrast factors (AAPL vs QQQ/NVDA volume z-scores, QQQ volume vs move size) gain in 2023 and 2025 but lose in 2022 and 2024, for both LR and RF. Price-based and range-position factors mostly fail. Pairs get 4/4 years but with little synergy beyond the sum of the two, so the team bar is hard to reach. The 2024 loss looks like a low-volatility trending regime where volume z-scores are noise, so I will try to gate or normalize the volume signals by regime. I will also try new directions that are not volume z-scores: multi-day overnight/intraday decomposition, and return autocorrelation or sign-consistency features.

lessons.name: qqq_volume_price_divergence_60d_range_scaled
lessons.lesson: The 60d window kept the QQQ volume-vs-move signal but lost in 2024 again, so a slower window did not fix the regime dependence and the pairs showed no synergy.

lessons.name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_gap_range_scaled_5d_avg
lessons.lesson: Averaging the volume gap over 3 days blurred the one-day signal and failed both 2022 and 2024, so the information is in the single-day spike.

lessons.name: aapl_dollar_volume_vs_msft_dollar_volume_trend
lessons.lesson: Slow 60d dollar volume gap against MSFT was noise with a large loss, so MSFT is a poor volume baseline for Apple.

lessons.name: aapl_volume_trend_slope_vs_price_move
lessons.lesson: A 5d volume trend versus 5d absolute move was too slow and hurt in 2024, helping only LR slightly.

lessons.name: aapl_return_gap_x_qqq_volume_price_div
lessons.lesson: Multiplying the AAPL-QQQ return gap by QQQ volume z-score was nearly neutral and only RF noticed, so the interaction added little beyond the plain volume factors.

lessons.name: aapl_volume_gap_vs_nvda_msft_dollar_flow
lessons.lesson: Dollar flow of NVDA+MSFT versus QQQ was far from Apple's own behaviour and gave only a 2025 RF gain, so it is mostly noise.

factors.name: qqq_volume_move_divergence_vol_regime_gated
factors.hypothesis: The parent lost in 2024, probably because the calm low-vol regime made the range denominator tiny and noisy; scaling by QQQ's 20d return volatility ties it to the regime level and should stabilise 2024.

factors.name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_surge_vs_vol_ratio
factors.hypothesis: The volume contrast fails in 2022 and 2024 when volume spikes carry no information; weighting it by short-vs-long Apple volatility keeps it only when Apple is actually turbulent.

factors.name: aapl_overnight_vs_intraday_20d
factors.hypothesis: Persistent overnight drift versus intraday drift over 10 days captures institutional versus retail flow balance, which is a different kind of information from volume z-scores or close-to-close returns.

factors.name: aapl_return_sign_consistency_10d
factors.hypothesis: The fraction of up days for Apple versus QQQ over 10 days measures breadth of Apple's relative strength and is robust to outliers, unlike mean returns.

factors.name: qqq_range_expansion_x_aapl_volume_gap
factors.hypothesis: The team factor uses Apple's range to scale volume; QQQ range relative to its 20d average describes market-wide turbulence, which should tell when Apple's volume contrast matters.

factors.name: aapl_minus_qqq_return_x_volume_gap_signed
factors.hypothesis: Signing Apple's volume surge by whether it beat QQQ today adds direction to the market volume-stress parent, describing whether Apple's relative move is confirmed by volume.
